assumed_fields: triage categories (not in a located source)

content.mission: Provide first aid to casualties, remove them for medical treatment or to safety, and provide and maintain an adequate emergency ambulance service.

sequence.label: First aid
sequence.action: Provide first aid to casualties and remove them for medical treatment or to areas of safety.

sequence.label: Take the handover
sequence.action: Ask members of the public who applied improvised first aid what the injury was and when any tie was applied above the wound.

sequence.label: Ambulance
sequence.action: Move casualties by the emergency ambulance service.

hand_offs.when: A hospital ED facing a spike from a major incident activates ambulance diversion; the hospital works with the ambulance crew.
